main.summary: Client-side upload session that persists local state and sends either finite segmented ranges or stream append extents to DataControl.

field.name: client
field.summary: The DataControl client used to issue segmented or stream transfer service calls.

field.name: storage
field.summary: The local working directory storage that persists segmented or stream upload state and source content.

field.name: token
field.summary: The optional bearer token used for authenticated service calls.

field.name: StreamSource
field.summary: The live stream source retained for stream-upload sessions.

field.name: CompletionMode
field.summary: The configured completion behavior used by one-call stream upload helpers.

field.name: MaxBytes
field.summary: The optional byte limit applied by bounded stream upload completion helpers.

field.name: PublishFinalStreamHash
field.summary: Controls whether the session should publish a final full-stream SHA-512 when committing a stream upload.

field.name: FinalStreamSHA512
field.summary: Cached final full-stream SHA-512 when it is already known from prepared finite staging or a prior commit-time resolution.

field.name: RunningStreamHash
field.summary: Optional same-session incremental SHA-512 state used while buffering live stream bytes into the staged local stream file.

field.name: RunningStreamHashLength
field.summary: Number of staged local stream bytes currently represented by the optional same-session incremental hash state.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a client-side upload session wrapper.
constructor.param: The DataControl client used for service calls.
The local working directory storage for the session.
Optional bearer token used for authenticated service calls.
The current persisted session metadata and transfer state.
Optional live source stream retained for stream-family upload sessions.
Configured completion behavior for stream-family uploads.
Optional maximum number of bytes the stream upload helper should append before stopping.
Controls whether the session should publish a final full-stream SHA-512 during stream-family commit.
Optional precomputed final full-stream SHA-512 captured during finite source preparation.

property.name: Session
property.summary: Gets the current local upload session metadata and transfer state snapshot.

method.name: UploadNext
method.summary: Upload the next planned finite range or stream append extent from the local persisted source content.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the next upload operation succeeds and local state is refreshed; otherwise false.

method.name: UploadSegmentNext
method.summary: Upload the next planned finite segmented range from the local persisted source content and return the exact range accepted for progress reporting.
method.returns: A task that completes with the exact segmented range uploaded and persisted locally, or null when no segmented upload can be performed or the operation does not succeed.

method.name: UploadToCompletion
method.summary: Upload remaining finite ranges or stream extents until the session reaches its configured stopping condition or no additional upload can be performed.
method.param: Optional progress receiver notified after each successfully uploaded finite segment or stream extent.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of successfully uploaded finite segments or stream extents.

method.name: Commit
method.summary: Finalize the upload session through segmented commit or stream completion and persist the resulting state locally.
method.param: Optional metadata-only final item payload for stream-family commits. When supplied, its ID is overwritten to the session item ID and its serialized payload becomes the committed object metadata while the uploaded stream bytes remain the session content.
method.returns: A task that completes with the finalized upload result, or null when completion is not possible or does not succeed.

method.name: CreateFinalCommittedObjectPayload
method.summary: Validate and serialize the optional final committed item payload for a stream-family commit.
method.param: The metadata-only final item whose ID is forced to the session item ID before serialization.
method.returns: The serialized final object payload to send with stream completion.
method.exception: Thrown when the supplied final item is null.
Thrown when the supplied final item cannot be forced to the session item ID or exposes FILE-backed, in-memory, or stream-returning content.

method.name: ResolveFinalStreamSHA512Async
method.summary: Resolve the final full-stream SHA-512 to publish for a stream-family commit using any prepared finite-source hash, same-session buffered hash state, or staged-file recomputation fallback.
method.param: Current stream upload state being committed.
method.returns: A task that completes with the final full-stream SHA-512 to publish, or an empty byte array when final stream hash publication is disabled.
method.exception: Thrown when final stream hash publication is enabled but the client cannot produce a valid full-stream hash for the staged local stream.

method.name: RecomputeFinalStreamSHA512Async
method.summary: Recompute the final full-stream SHA-512 from the staged local stream file when no prepared or same-session hash is available.
method.param: Current stream upload state whose staged local stream file should be hashed.
method.returns: A task that completes with the recomputed SHA-512 when the staged local stream file is available and length-consistent; otherwise null.

method.name: DeleteLocalState
method.summary: Delete the local working directory state for the current upload session without contacting the service.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the local session state directory is deleted successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: RemoveTransfer
method.summary: Remove the retained remote upload transfer session and delete the corresponding local working directory state.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the remote removal succeeds and local state is removed; otherwise false.

method.name: Abort
method.summary: Abort the remote upload session and delete the corresponding local working directory state.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the remote abort succeeds and local state is removed; otherwise false.

method.name: CreateProgress
method.summary: Create a transfer progress snapshot for a completed uploaded range.
method.param: The refreshed transfer state after the successful upload.
The range that was most recently uploaded.
method.returns: A progress snapshot describing the updated upload state.

method.name: UploadStreamNext
method.summary: Upload the next available buffered stream extent, replenishing the local buffer from the retained source stream when needed, and refresh persisted stream state.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when a stream extent upload succeeds and local state is refreshed; otherwise false.

method.name: PlanNextRange
method.summary: Plan the next upload range from the first normalized missing range using the effective segment size policy.
method.remarks: The algorithm starts from the first missing range. It then clamps the preferred segment size into the configured minimum and maximum bounds. If taking that planned prefix would leave behind a non-terminal tail smaller than the minimum segment size, the current request is reduced so the remaining tail grows back to at least the minimum size. When no split is needed, the original missing range is returned unchanged.

method.name: BufferNextStreamPayload
method.summary: Append the next chunk of bytes from the retained live stream source into the local buffered stream file.
method.param: The local buffered stream file path.
The maximum number of bytes to buffer from the live source.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of bytes appended to the local buffered stream file.

method.name: HasReachedConfiguredByteLimit
method.summary: Determine whether the current stream upload state has reached the configured maximum byte count.
method.returns: True when a maximum byte count is configured and the appended length meets or exceeds it; otherwise false.

method.name: PlanNextAppendLength
method.summary: Plan the next stream extent length using the effective preferred segment size and any configured byte limit.
method.returns: The number of bytes to attempt to buffer and upload next.

method.name: DisposeStreamSource
method.summary: Dispose the retained live stream source using asynchronous disposal when available.
method.returns: A value task that completes when disposal has finished.
